title: Tea at the Summit
description: Eleanor climbs through the snow toward a mountain summit, carrying tea, an urn, and the promise of one final moment with someone she loved.
excerpt: Eleanor has spent two days climbing toward the summit. At the top, with a flask of rose tea and a small urn beside her, the true reason for her journey is revealed.
author: from-a-storyteller
